headline: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen at APEC summit
source: Axios and Reuters, via Just Security
pages: Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted President Trump on the tarmac when he landed in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, a break from usual protocol. Democracy Now reported that the two leaders shook hands and hugged. A meeting that also includes Russian President Vladimir Putin is planned on the sidelines of the summit for Thursday, according to Democracy Now. Just Security reported that Xi pledged to stand against trade protectionism, and that Putin called Western powers former hegemons. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said he will also meet Trump at the gathering.

The talks matter because trade, the war in Ukraine, and the Gulf conflict all sit on the agenda of three of the world's most powerful governments.
Source: Axios and Reuters, via Just Security
